_comment: The company's social media profiles, shown as icons in the footer of every public page. Add only real MR Software profile URLs. Each entry is { "network": "linkedin" | "youtube" | "facebook" | "instagram" | "github", "href": "https://..." } and the address must be on that network's own domain. The list is empty on purpose until the profile URLs are confirmed; an empty list shows nothing. After editing, run npm run build:links.
